title: This Bird Chases Others Until They Throw Up, Then Steals the Meal

scenes.text: This bird makes other birds throw up.
Frigatebirds chase boobies and tropicbirds in the air.
They harass them until they cough up their catch.
Then they snatch the food before it hits the water.
For great frigatebirds, stolen food is only about 5 percent of the diet.
The rest they catch themselves, like flying fish and squid.

description:
Frigatebirds chase other seabirds in the air until they drop or throw up their food, then catch it before it hits the water.
For great frigatebirds, stolen meals are only about 5 percent of the diet.
Would you call that clever or rude?
first_comment: Which animal do you think is the biggest thief?
